title: Prometheus 2: An open source language model specialized in evaluating other language models
authors_zh: Seungone Kim、Juyoung Suk、Shayne Longpre、Bill Yuchen Lin、Jamin Shin、Sean Welleck、Graham Neubig、Moontae Lee、Kyungjae Lee、Minjoon Seo
paper_type_zh: 后训练数据、偏好、奖励或评测研究
best_for_zh: 研究 LLM 后训练反馈数据与 verifier 的读者。
one_line: Releases Prometheus 2, an open judge model that accepts custom rubrics and supports both absolute scoring and pairwise comparison.
发布 Prometheus 2 开放裁判模型：接收用户自定义量规，同时输出绝对评分与成对比较，替代不透明的闭源评判器。
why: It exposes a feedback, preference, reward, rubric, safety, or post-training data surface that must be audited before reuse.
inclusion_reason: Candidate paper on an open evaluator model with an official arXiv primary link.

title: Problem
问题
html: Prometheus 2 is motivated by an evaluation dependency problem. In many open-model studies, GPT-4 or another closed model is asked to score answers, yet the evaluator’s rubric, calibration, cost, version, and failure modes are not reproducible. The paper specializes an open language model for evaluation so that the criterion can be supplied by the user and the evaluator itself can be inspected, rerun, and compared. Its target is not “a better chatbot”; it is the decision function that stands between a candidate output and a score or preference label.
Prometheus 2 针对的是评估依赖问题：许多开放模型研究让 GPT‑4 或其他闭源模型给回答打分，但评估器的量规、校准、成本、版本和失败模式都不可复现。论文把开放语言模型专门训练为评估器，使标准可由用户提供，评估器本身也可检查、重跑和比较。它的目标不是“更好的聊天机器人”，而是候选输出与分数或偏好标签之间的决策函数。

title: Core idea
核心思路
html: The model accepts an instruction, one response or a pair of responses, and a custom evaluation criterion. It must map this context into either a direct assessment score or a pairwise decision. These modes impose distinct contracts: a direct score needs an interpretable scale and calibration across examples, whereas a pairwise decision needs answer-order invariance and a tie policy. Prometheus 2’s use of a user-defined rubric is useful only if that rubric is recorded verbatim; changing “correct” to “helpful and concise” changes the task.
模型接收指令、一个回答或一对回答以及自定义评价标准，再输出直接评分或成对决定。这两种模式有不同契约：直接分数需要跨样本可解释的刻度与校准，成对判断需要回答顺序不变性和并列政策。Prometheus 2 的用户定义量规只有在被逐字记录时才有意义；把“正确”改成“有帮助且简洁”就改变了任务。

title: Method
方法
html: The authors train an evaluator model and test it on four direct-assessment benchmarks and four pairwise-ranking benchmarks. The public prometheus-eval release packages models, code, and data references. A reproduction should preserve the checkpoint, chat template, rubric text, response ordering, generation parameters, parsing rule, score range, and aggregation metric. When a benchmark already contains a criterion, state whether it was passed through unchanged or rewritten, because rubric paraphrases can alter a judge’s decision.
作者训练评估器，并在 4 个直接评分基准和 4 个成对排序基准上测试。公开 prometheus-eval 发布包含模型、代码和数据引用。复现应固定检查点、聊天模板、量规文本、回答顺序、生成参数、解析规则、分数范围和聚合指标。若基准自带标准，必须说明是原样传入还是改写，因为量规释义会改变裁判决定。

title: Evidence
证据
html: The paper reports that Prometheus 2 has the highest correlation or agreement with humans and proprietary judges among the compared open evaluators on the eight stated benchmarks. This is evidence of relative evaluator agreement under those protocols, not proof that the model is an objective oracle. Humans and strong closed judges can share blind spots; high correlation can coexist with systematic errors on rare safety, factuality, multilingual, or domain-expert cases.
论文报告，在所比较开放评估器中，Prometheus 2 在所述 8 个基准上与人类及专有裁判的相关性或一致性最高。这只是特定协议下的相对评估器一致性证据，不证明模型是客观神谕。人类和强闭源裁判可能共享盲点；高相关仍可能在罕见安全、事实、多语种或专业领域案例上系统出错。

title: Novelty
新意
html: A key result is that direct evaluation and pairwise ranking need not be separate proprietary services. An open evaluator can serve both when trained to follow a criterion. This makes it possible to audit the full evaluation prompt and model weights, and to use the same judge in a controlled ablation. The contribution is not the invention of LLM-as-a-judge prompting; it is an open, criterion-conditioned judge intended to close the gap with stronger evaluators across both common interfaces.
一个重要结果是，直接评估和成对排序不必由彼此分离的专有服务完成。开放评估器在被训练为遵循标准后可以兼顾两者，这使研究者能审计完整评估提示和模型权重，并在受控消融中使用同一裁判。贡献不在发明 LLM-as-a-Judge，而在提供面向两种常用接口、可量规条件化的开放裁判。

title: Limitations
局限
html: Judge prompts are fragile. Length bias, position bias, self-preference, verbosity, criterion ambiguity, refusal bias, and score-range collapse can change outputs. A model may generate a detailed explanation that rationalizes a wrong verdict. Before using it as a reward source, evaluate response-order swaps, multiple rubric phrasings, calibration curves, ties, and disagreement with independent experts. Do not use a single judge call as the only safety or correctness gate.
裁判提示很脆弱。长度偏差、位置偏差、自偏好、冗长偏好、量规歧义、拒答偏差和分数范围塌缩都会改变输出。模型还可能写出详细解释来为错误结论辩护。把它用作奖励来源前，应测试回答交换、多种量规表述、校准曲线、并列和相对独立专家的分歧；不能把一次裁判调用作为唯一安全或正确性门槛。

title: Usefulness
用途
html: Prometheus 2 is useful as a transparent baseline for response evaluation, for rubric-conditioned data filtering, and for experiments comparing direct scores with pairwise preferences. It is most valuable when a research claim needs a reproducible evaluator rather than an undocumented API call. It does not replace reference answers, executable tests, or domain professionals when the task has an external verifier or high consequences.
Prometheus 2 适合作为透明的回答评估基线、量规条件化的数据过滤器，以及直接分数与成对偏好比较实验。它在研究主张需要可复现评估器、而非未记录 API 调用时最有价值。若任务有参考答案、可执行测试或高风险后果，它不能替代这些外部验证器或领域专家。

title: Reading notes
阅读笔记
html: A replication log should keep the raw prompt and raw judge completion for every decision. Record model revision, evaluation-instruction template, criterion, candidate ordering, temperature, max tokens, direct-score mapping, pairwise tie rule, and benchmark-specific aggregation. Analyze separately whether an error came from misunderstanding the task, ignoring the rubric, choosing the wrong answer, or emitting an unparsable format. These diagnostics are more informative than an average agreement alone.
复现实验日志应保存每个决定的原始提示和原始裁判完成。记录模型版本、系统提示、标准、候选顺序、温度、最大 token、直接分数映射、成对并列规则及基准特定聚合。还应分别分析错误来自误解任务、忽略量规、选错回答还是输出不可解析格式；这些诊断比平均一致性更有信息量。
